title: American Convention on Human Rights Article 5 — Right to Humane Treatment, Prohibition of Degrading Treatment via Public Confrontation
category: International Aviation / Human Rights / Treaty Law

incident.location: Santiago International Airport (SCL), aboard aircraft LA8159 and Gate Area, Chile

allegation_summary: Passenger [[SPK-passenger-leandro]] was subjected to degrading treatment in violation of Article 5 of the American Convention on Human Rights. While seated aboard the aircraft among fellow passengers, he was publicly accused of aggression — a criminal allegation — by LATAM crew, ordered to deplane in a confrontational manner, and forcibly removed by armed PDI officers in view of other passengers. The public nature of the false accusation, the physical removal despite compliance, and the subsequent imposition of a lifetime ban (effective public branding as a security threat) collectively constitute treatment that degrades the passenger's physical, mental, and moral integrity as protected by Article 5(1) and crosses the threshold of cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment prohibited by Article 5(2).
